nodes.norm_label: residential proxy providers (bright data / oxylabs / smartproxy)

nodes.label: launchPersistentContext switch
nodes.rationale: Persistent context fixes the '(Incognito Window)' flag: real storage quota ~297 GB vs ephemeral ~1.3 GB.

nodes.label: Proxy health-aware rotation (markBanned / markSuccess)
nodes.rationale: Disables a proxy for 30 min after 3 failures; success resets fail count.

nodes.label: Stealth addInitScript patch chain
nodes.rationale: Init scripts override navigator.userAgentData, outerHeight/availHeight/storage.persist, readPixels on 256x24 canvas, and MessageEvent.prototype.data to align spoofed fingerprint signals with headless Chromium.

nodes.label: monitoring compose profile
nodes.rationale: Observability is opt-in to keep the default stack light.

nodes.label: Redis URL cache (TTL 24h)
nodes.rationale: Cost control: cache hits skip scraping entirely.

nodes.label: pixelscan jsModifyDetected root cause (top.MD5 missing)
nodes.rationale: fptc canvasHash/webglHash throw because pixelscan's MD5 module is not exposed on window, so frameFpCollect lacks keys and mismatches selfFpCollect; proposed fix is injecting window.MD5 via addInitScript.

nodes.label: parseSafely graceful parse error handling
nodes.rationale: Parse errors are stored as {parseError:true} with status failed instead of retrying, since retries would not fix a selector mismatch.

nodes.label: BrowserPoolService (Playwright context pool)
nodes.rationale: Acquire/release/destroy with 20-cycle reuse to amortize browser startup while limiting fingerprint staleness.

nodes.label: Job Retry Policy (SCRAPER_JOB_ATTEMPTS x 3 in-process retries)
nodes.norm_label: job retry policy (scraper_job_attempts x 3 in-process retries)

nodes.label: Legal Notice (LinkedIn ToS, GDPR, CFAA, robots.txt)
nodes.norm_label: legal notice (linkedin tos, gdpr, cfaa, robots.txt)
nodes.rationale: Scraping is restricted to authorized collection, own-account data, or research; license grants no rights to scrape third-party sites.

nodes.label: Runtime Navigation Guard
nodes.rationale: Submission-time validation cannot stop redirects; at runtime the guard aborts redirects leaving LinkedIn and requests to loopback/private/link-local/docker-internal hosts, and such jobs fail immediately without retries.

nodes.label: SSRF Protection (LinkedIn-only https URLs)
nodes.rationale: Job URLs must be https LinkedIn URLs on the default port; other hosts are rejected to prevent SSRF via the headless browser.

nodes.label: Docker Compose (app + PostgreSQL + Redis + monitoring profile)
nodes.norm_label: docker compose (app + postgresql + redis + monitoring profile)

nodes.label: Redis URL Caching (24h TTL)
nodes.rationale: Cost control: avoid re-scraping the same URL within 24h.
